Your project checklist

Six details worth sharing.

01 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Electrical load

Required voltage, energy, continuous load and startup or peak current.

02 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Physical integration

Dimensions, mounting, connector type, cable length and available space.

03 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Operating environment

Temperature, storage conditions, exposure and the way the device is used.

01 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Charging architecture

Charging method, charger interface and any device-level charging requirements.

02 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Compliance & documents

Destination market, applicable standards and the test reports you need.

03 / PROJECT CONSIDERATION

Project scope

Expected quantities, sample requirements and the development schedule.

Technical context

Energy and capacity.
Keep the units clear.

Ampere-hours and watt-hours describe different things. Always use the selected product’s actual specifications.

BASIC ENERGY RELATIONSHIP

Wh = V × Ah

Watt-hours express stored energy. Ampere-hours express charge capacity at a given voltage. Use nominal voltage and capacity values from the actual model datasheet.

Usable runtime also depends on load, conversion losses, operating conditions and product limits. Confirm performance for the selected configuration; a calculation is not a guarantee of runtime.

How do I discuss customization?
